_about: Character art slots (ui/portrait.tsx, brief Addendum A). Add an entry per id to replace the drawn placeholder: { "src": "art/<file>.png", "alt": "...", "moods": { "hesitant": "...", "confident": "...", "mischief": "..." } }. Ids: src:kitman src:barber src:agent src:spotter src:physio src:leak · rival:tabloid rival:itk rival:insider · editor:mags editor:hana editor:desk · me · player:<playerId>. Never bake a name, club, badge, sponsor or status into the image: those are live text beside the slot.
